opening.argument: The strongest evidence is the visible banking walkthrough: a Wells Fargo screen explains card-free ATM access, and another shows a requested access code with an expiration countdown. The speaker describes obtaining that code through the app and using it at an ATM. The PIN discussion remains part of that process, and the speaker explicitly warns that giving someone else a PIN is risky. The separate Cash App referral is presented as a stated $5 promotion, but the available evidence does not show whether it was completed, honored, or deceptive. What is shown primarily explains how the card-free ATM process works.

citations.quote: So what you want to do is use the receiver function to the ATM card in the app and get the code that I can get right now.
